product_metadata.title: Leegoal Super Cute Fantastic Strawberry Design Silicone Tea Infuser Strainer Teapot Teacup (Red)
description: Here is a cute way to brew your daily tea in an eco-minded fashion. Our line of fruit tea infusers are made of 100% LSR Platinum Silicone (the same safe stuff used for baby bottles) and can be disinfected in boiling water. Because tea strainers use loose tea, they are the eco-friendly way to brew since they do away with wasteful individual tea bags.
